name: Somniac
storyline: Trapped in a dream for what feels like years, despite being only a soul, you wish to attempt to escape the dream and wake up. Far, far easier said than done.
summary:
You will not escape.

Trapped in a dream for what feels like years, despite being only a soul, you wish to attempt to escape the dream and wake up. Far, far easier said than done.

Somniac is a Roguelike Platformer with unusual movement that will force you to master something you're not used to. On top of that, the game takes complete pride in the slightest mistake costing the entire run.
